FFmpeg runtime notice

This application invokes FFmpeg as a separate local subprocess to remux
captured HLS media into MP4 files. The distributed runtime is the BtbN
win64 LGPL shared build identified in SOURCE_INFO.txt.

The complete applicable license text is included in LICENSE.txt. The
application does not include FFmpeg source code or modify the FFmpeg source.
This notice documents engineering distribution information and is not legal
advice. Commercial release should receive a final license review before
public distribution.
